__doc__: TES4 journal text -> short Skyrim objective line (NNAM). Skyrim renders two quest strings: the long log entry (CNAM) in the journal and a short imperative line (NNAM) on the objective HUD. TES4 authored only ONE string per stage, so this table supplies the short form. Keyed on the SOURCE TEXT after whitespace normalisation (' '.join(text.split())), matching dialog_converter's post-_pc_stage_texts value. Sources: Oblivion.esm, Morrowind_ob.esm, Nehrim.esm (German), Translation.esp (English). An entry is present only when it CHANGES the line: identical text is a no-op, since the fallback yields the same string. Length is deliberately NOT a criterion -- a short source can still be retrospective prose that needs rewriting into an imperative.
